note: Carried by MergeProof.Ribbons.quilled: the two per-mark rates are the relayed Note facts hg and he, then combined via pica. Difference: they appear as local Note statements (logarithmic rate with o(1)) inside quilled, not as separate displayed identities.

snippet.text:
lemma quilled : Note C.S Z' (-D + M) :=by
   have hg:= plumN C d hG a ha|>.relay j hj hT; have he:= ((plumN C 4 hG b hb).relay j hj hT).splits (((fuchsia C hG hV).scales C.path.levels.fits.mesh).powerN h); unfold ventola
   apply ((pica _ hG _ hT hj hV (w:=A) false (by exact hg)).mills (pica _ hG _ hT hj hV (w:=A) true (by exact he))).swapP
   have hi:(d:ℝ)+4-h=D:=by exact sub_eq_of_eq_add (by exact_mod_cast hp.symm)
   push_cast; rw [←hi]; ring

proof_context.conclusion: The degree-d rate (plumN d relayed to j, hg) and the degree-4 rate times rho^h (plumN 4 with fuchsia powered by h, he) are combined into the joint rate -D + M.
